summary: Northern States Power Company (NSP-Minnesota), a wholly owned subsidiary of Xcel Energy Inc., filed an 8-K to disclose a verbal order from the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission on June 18, 2026, in its 2024 Minnesota electric rate case. The decision includes an estimated $211 million rate increase over two years (2.9% average annually), a 9.60% return on equity (up from 9.25%), and a maintained 52.5% equity ratio. A final written order is expected by July 31, 2026. Xcel reaffirmed its 2026 ongoing EPS guidance of $4.04–$4.16. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation.
